items.why_fit: Ghost is a product company with visible public updates and a support channel, and they run a release cadence suited to a small GitHub automation workflow.
items.subject: GitHub release automation for Ghost teams
items.message:
Hi team, I noticed Ghost publishes product updates and support resources in a structured way, and your public contact page makes it straightforward to reach the right team. I created a small GitHub automation pack at https://raw.githack.com/amoedo7/RankingIAMO/main/offers/RANK-IAMO519/index.html that turns merged PRs into a clean changelog, applies release labels, and sends a short deploy summary.
